name: What should I do first if my kitchen layout makes no sense?

mainEntity.name: What should I do first if my kitchen layout makes no sense?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start with a measured drawing of the existing kitchen, including wall lengths, ceiling height, doors, windows, appliances, plumbing points, electrical outlets, and nearby rooms. A layout can look attractive on paper but fail when refrigerator doors, walkways, or cabinet depths are measured incorrectly. Key factors include your cooking habits, household size, storage needs, desired seating, and whether walls or utilities may change. Before contacting Elite Remodeling & Design, photograph each wall and note what frustrates you during meal preparation. Their design-build process can then connect layout development with construction requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Begin with accurate measurements and a list of daily problems. Record walls, openings, utilities, appliance sizes, storage shortages, and traffic patterns before choosing cabinets or finishes. Elite Remodeling & Design can use that information to develop a practical layout connected to the construction plan.
